template: In Odoo Sales (already signed in as admin), there is an unsaved new quotation form for customer '{{v1}}' with an open 'Configure your product' modal blocking it. Resolve this so the quotation ends up SAVED with exactly ONE order line: quantity 3 of a product chosen from the product autocomplete dropdown, with Odoo's auto-filled unit price. If clicking Cancel on the modal drops the line or the product keeps re-opening the configurator, pick a different product that does not trigger the configurator modal. Then click Save and verify the record is persisted (statusbar no longer 'New', a record id appears in the URL). Report: (a) the product name on the line, (b) the unit price, (c) the Untaxed Amount shown, and (d) confirmation the quotation is saved (e.g. its reference/name if shown). Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

Re-read from the live page: exactly ONE order line — '[E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors', quantity 3.00, unit price 140.00 (Odoo auto-filled), line tax-excl £420.00; footer shows Untaxed Amount £420.00, TAX 20% £84.00, Total £504.00; customer {{v1}} (Benchville) is on the form and the statusbar shows 'Quotation' (not 'New'), with a record id=22 in the URL and a chatter entry 'Sales Order created'. I therefore made no changes (nothing was saved/deleted/cancelled in this run) — the earlier configurator-modal blockage had already been cleared by removing that configurable-product line and re-adding a plain product, and the record is persisted.
